text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High GPU queue growth detected in us-west1-primary (gpu-pool-primary). Autoscaler failed to provision new nodes (error: quota_exceeded). Current queue depth: 14k requests. Latency p95 >= 3.5s. Triggered cross-region spillover to eu-west1, but several requests are failing. Pager: paged alice.sre and dan.ml-oncall.

pagerduty: Paging alice.sre (on-call). Incident severity: P1.

alice.sre: ack — investigating. Can someone post the autoscaler errors?

bob.runtime: Copying logs from runtime:```
2026-03-15T09:12:05Z autoscaler: scale_up failed -> provider error: quota_exceeded: GPUs per project limit
2026-03-15T09:12:07Z runtime: enqueue request id=abcd token_count=120 model=gpt-medium region=us-west1 status=queued
2026-03-15T09:12:15Z router: spillover initiated -> dest=eu-west1 route_policy=latency-first
2026-03-15T09:12:40Z router: spillover retry failed -> connection_reset
```

carla.infra: Confirmed: cloud provider returned 403 when requesting additional A100s. Quota shows at hard limit. No recent requests to increase.

dan.ml-oncall: On call — seeing model variant mismatch errors in eu-west1: runtime expects quantized-v2 but eu-west1 pool has quantized-v1 cached -> kv-cache misses + recompile latency spike. That explains the failed spillover.

erin.cs: We have incoming customer reports of 502s and timeouts from a handful of accounts on EU customers trying then US. Need comms asap.

alice.sre: OK. Triage plan: 1) Short-term mitigation to restore customer traffic: enable manual routing to east1 fallback pool (east1-hot-spot) and throttle noncritical background jobs. 2) Mid-term: request emergency quota bump or provision dedicated reserved capacity. 3) Post-incident: root cause and prevention.

frank.platform: I'll flip routing if ops approves. Note: east1 has capacity but model cache warmup will take ~45s. Suggest also enabling lightweight fallback model (gpt-small) to serve degraded but success responses.

bob.runtime: Proposed commands:```
# route traffic away from us-west1 primary
routectl set-preference --from-region us-west1 --to-region east1 --weight 0.9 --reason "emergency"
# disable background batch jobs for 10m
jobsctl pause --tag=batch-noncritical --duration 10m
```

carla.infra: Initiating quota support request now. Filed ticket with cloud provider (case #CP-2026-314). ETA 2-3 hours unless emergency approved.

dan.ml-oncall: Starting model warmup on east1: pushing quantized-v2 and setting cache prewarm flag. Command:```
modelctl deploy-cache --model quantized-v2 --region east1 --prewarm=true --concurrency 8
```

erin.cs: I'll draft a short customer message: "We're seeing elevated latency and timeouts in our generation API for a subset of customers. We're routing traffic to a fallback region; you may see slight quality degradation for a short time. We'll update with ETA."

alice.sre: frank, execute the routectl now after pausing batches. I'll coordinate validation.

frank.platform: done: `routectl set-preference --from-region us-west1 --to-region east1 --weight 0.95 --reason "emergency capacity overflow"` — responses now routed to east1.
bob.runtime: Verification: router metrics show spillover rate dropping in us-west1, east1 accepted ~6k RPS. Some 503s still present due to model mismatch.

carla.infra: Background jobs paused. Also draining a set of lower-critical GPU pools (batch-worker-*) to free capacity for inference.

dan.ml-oncall: Cache warmup logs:```
2026-03-15T09:18:30Z modelctl: pushing quantized-v2 to east1...
2026-03-15T09:18:50Z modelctl: prewarm completed for 6/8 shards
2026-03-15T09:19:10Z cache status: warm -> ready
```

bob.runtime: Good — error rate to east1 down from 15%->1.2% in last 2m. Latency p95 in east1 at 2.1s. us-west1 queue still large but stable.

erin.cs: Sent initial customer notice to impacted accounts and status page updated.

alice.sre: Next: block further spillover to eu-west1 until kv-cache parity verified. frank, can you update policy to remove eu-west1 as an automatic spill target?

frank.platform: done: `routectl remove-spill-target --region eu-west1 --effective now`

carla.infra: Also adding a temporary autoscaler override to allow manual provisioning if provider approves:```
autoscalerctl set-override --pool gpu-pool-primary --allowed-provision=0 --manual-route=/ops/allow-emergency
``` — set to 0 to prevent further failed attempts (we don't want repeated quota errors), manual route will be used if provider confirms.

alice.sre: Good. For immediate capacity: we should also spin up reserved instances in east1 as a short-lived dedicated pool. frank, coordinate with finance if needed for emergency spend.

frank.platform: spinning reserved pool in east1 (temp-dedicated-264005) — provisioning started. Might take ~6m.

pagerduty: alice.sre acknowledged the incident. On-call rotation unchanged.

dan.ml-oncall: Observed another class of failures: tokenization microservice timeouts when requests re-route across regions. Setting retry policy to 2s backoff to avoid thundering-herd.```
configctl set tokenization.timeout=2000ms
configctl set router.retry_backoff=2000ms
```

bob.runtime: Implemented local client-side degrade: if model not available in remote region, fall back to smaller-model path. Pushed patch to live config:```
config: {
  fallback_model_priority: ["gpt-small","gpt-medium","gpt-large"]
}
```

erin.cs: Customer-impact snapshot: ~120 accounts saw increased latency; ~8 accounts reported 5xx errors. CS engaged and doing one-off mitigations for enterprise customers.

alice.sre: After mitigations, system stabilized. us-west1 queue depth trending down: 14k -> 2.1k over 22m. Error rates returned to baseline. We'll keep incident open until reserved pool active + quota case progresses.

carla.infra: Cloud provider updated: they can expedite GPU quota increase if we provide justification. Filing for emergency uplift. Ticket updated CP-2026-314 -> escalated.

frank.platform: Reserved pool in east1 provisioned and warm. Shunting critical routes to reserved pool; monitoring.

bob.runtime: Verified end-to-end: p95 now 1.2s global; error rate <0.5%. Good.

erin.cs: Sent final update to customers: degraded-quality fallback used briefly; most requests unaffected after 25m. Thanks to SRE and infra teams for fast mitigation.

alice.sre: Post-incident action items (brief): 1) Add automated cache parity check before routing spillover. 2) Block autoscaler retry storms on quota_exceeded (circuit breaker). 3) Create runbook step to spin reserved pool in fallback region. 4) Run tabletop for cross-region failover. I'll create tasks.

dan.ml-oncall: Also add model-version tagging in control plane so router can check model variant before routing.

erin.cs: CS follow-up: outbound emails + dedicated post-incident bridge for affected enterprise accounts.

alice.sre: Thanks all. Closing on-call handoff in 15m but leaving incident thread open for postmortem notes.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration: 00:40:39. Postmortem assigned to alice.sre and carla.infra.

frank.platform: Reaction :thumbsup: and creating follow-up epic in backlog (INF-1742).

alice.sre: Closing updates in 1h after verification window. Great job everyone.
